(cha)༄༅/ /dpal lhun grub steng srib dgon gtsug lag khang du bskang gso rtag 'don gyi gtan 'jog yi ge mi 'gyur tshangs pa'i drang thig ces bya ba bzhugs

tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// dpal lhun grub steng srib dgon gtsug lag khang du bskang gso rtag 'don gyi gtan 'jog yi ge mi 'gyur tshangs pa'i drang thig ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// māttaṇḍāyāratnasuwarṇaṇasyasumeruṃ.āliṃgityaḥrasmikarebhishshatamewātra/ niḥshreyansishyabhyudayetāsharaṇamhiḥ kātsiddhūtaṃpālayashauddhaudanināhiḥ/

༄༅// rin chen gser gyi lhun por ma zlum gyi// 'od zer lag pas lan brgyar 'khyud mtshungs las// skyabs su song bas mngon mtho nges legs dpal// ci yang 'byung ba zas gtsang sras kyis skyongs// bde gshegs bka' don smra ba'i mkhas khyod kyi// legs bshad bdud rtsis gzu lum 'doms pa'i snying*// mi bzad zug rngu bskyed na kun dga'i dpal// ster ba'i snying po rigs sam sa skya pa// kun phan dkyil 'khor legs mthong tshangs pa'i bu// yid srubs longs spyod rnam 'phrul 'dod ldan bzhin// kun dga'i lugs mchog 'doms pa'i dbang phyug gang*// skal bzang mkhas pa mang pos gtsug gi bsten// sngon rabs thang chen stong pa'i ljongs 'di na// chos srol dang por 'byed pa'i rgyal por thos// brtson 'grus kyis bskyed thar pa'i khang pa bzang*// bskrun pa'i bka' drin mes po'i rjes su dran// mnga' ris khams bod gtogs pa'i rigs can gsum// theg gsum chos kyi smra mkhas gang dag byon// kun gyi rtogs brjod dran pa de nas bzung*// smra mchog grags pa gzhan la gus pa lhod// rno mtshon gdengs dang mda' lnga'i bdag po grogs// bkug min na yang mkhas tshul gsum skyong ba// ljongs kyi dkyil 'khor drin du che ba'i mchog /ji snyed byon pa'i zhabs rdul gtsug tu bkod// gom gsum gnon pas ma bcad tshangs pa'i bkas// byin min tha gru rab yangs dbyig 'dzin khyon// sde bzhi dge bcu'i dbang sgyur chos ldan gyi// sa gzhi skyong chen thams cad bsngags pa'i 'os// phun tshogs sde bzhi rgyas 'gyur sa'i thig ler// dge ba'i mtshan mas bsu ba'i gtsug lag khang*// rgyal ba sras dang bstan srung rab 'byams tshogs// dngos grub sbyin pa'i phyag rgya rkyong snyam byed// yon tan gter gyur de dag mchod pa'i yon// phra mos dgyes 'dod blo 'di ci las skyes// 'on te ston pa'i mchog la bgres mos sngon// mar me phul bas 'tshang rgya 'gyur bar bstan// bsam sbyor dge bas kun bslangs mchod pa'i rgyun// chung yang bla ma'i bka' lung mi bzlog phyir// lha srung rgya mtsho mchod pa'i gtan 'jog gi

/bkod pa mi nyams yi ge'i lam du spel// zhes mchod brjod dngos po nges bstan gyi ngag nyung ngus mdun bsu nas/ skabs su bab pa'i gleng ba/ bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa bla na med pa shākya seng ges legs par gsungs pa 'phags pa dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i mdo las/ ji skad du/ de tshe 'jig rten mgon po'i sprul pa sprul// de tshe dge slong kun dga' bzang po 'byung*// tshul khrims kyis kyang khyad par 'phags gyur la// thos pa mang zhing pha rol phyin pas 'phags// thabs dang shes rab la ni shin tu bslabs// zhes sogs dang*/ gzhan yang dam chos padma dkar po sogs nas lung bstan pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po zhes mtshan gyi ba dan dkar po srid pa'i rtser 'phyo ba gang des kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan par mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang*/ phrin las gzhal du med pas/ 'gro ba rgya mtsho skal ba mchog gi bdud rtsi'i ro la sbyor ba'i dus kyi zhabs zung chu skyes mngon par bkod pa'i chos khri chen po padma rā ga'i kha dog can gang du/ srid zhi'i shis pa kun gyis rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ba'i sdom gsum smra ba'i nyi ma gang dag byon pa las/ gdan rabs so gsum par gyur pa mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa nyid/ sde dge khri chen bla ma kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho pa sku mched zhal 'dzom pa'i bsod nams gser gyi shing rtas lcags sprel gyi lor ljongs 'dir spyan drangs nas khyi lo'i bar bgrang gzhi bco lngar bzhugs/ slar dbus gtsang phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo sgyur nye ba na/ par dpon dge slong tshul khrims ting 'dzin can la 'di skad du stsal te/ dpal lhu grub steng gi srib dgon gyi gtsug lag khang 'di ni/ sngon dus sde dge'i yang mes bo thar zhes bya ba gtsug lag zung gi yul la rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros gsal zhing*/

bstan srid kyi spyod pa'i khur chen 'degs pa la/ legs bris kyi gtso bo'i snying stobs rdzogs pa gang des/ grub pa'i dbang phyug brtson 'grus bzang po'am/ ji skad du/ khyab bdal chen po'i thang chen na// stong nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// 'jigs med rgyal po lta bur bzhugs// de phyir thang stong rgyal por thogs// zhes ye shes kyi ḍā kis thang stong rgyal po zhes mtshan du gsol ba gang des/ mngon par shes pa dang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa grub pas/ dag pa'i zhing rab 'byams dang*/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul gru kun du gshegs bzhud la ngal ba mi mnga' bar/ gdul bya grangs med pa ngan 'gro dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa bzlog ste/ bde ba rgyu dang bcas par dngos dang brgyud pas dgod cing gshegs pa dang mjal te mchod gnas su thob/ grub chen des ye shes gzigs pa'i me long du/ srib ri'i zhol du dgon sde btab na bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dar ba sogs kyi dge mtshan gyi gzugs brnyan shar bar brten/ der gtsug lag khang dgon dud rnams dang bcas pa bskrun nas/ der chos srung gi bsnyen pa mdzad nas gnyer gtad bcol/ de nas brtsams te ljongs 'dir bstan srid nyi zla zung 'brel gyi snang ba dam pas phyogs bral khyab pa'i bkra shis kyi sgo brgya phrag phye/ de ltar nyin dgon nub kyi mgon khang du bzhugs pa'i gsang mgon ye shes pa mngon sum du zhugs par grags pa 'di nyid kyang der bzhugs pa nas spyan drangs par grags/ khri chen sangs rgyas bstan pa sogs kyi sku ring la srib dgon gyi gtsug lag khang nyams gso ldebs bris kyi bdag rkyen tsam las dus mchod dang bskang gso sogs ni ma gnang 'dug nged kyis gsang mgon gyi sku tshab lta bur lder bzo'i mgon sku khru tshad tsam zhig bzhengs nas bzhag yod/ da dung gtsug lag khang der bskang gso rgyun 'don legs pa zhig btsugs na/

spyir sa ngor bstan pa'i phrin las mi nub pa dang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu spyi dang*/ sgos su sde dge gong ma bstan jus la sku drin can byon pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ da ltar zhal bzhugs pa rnams kyi sku tshe bsod nams phrin las mi brgyud rgyun mi chad pa'i rim gror phan skyed 'byung ba sogs grub chen gong ma rnams kyi thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi mthu btsan por yod pa the tshom mi dgos mod/ de sngon nged rang gis ni rang gzhan don du zhu bya mang 'gro bas snyan sgron 'bul skabs zhig ma 'phrod pas/ slar khyed rnam pa lta bu zhig gis 'phros gleng 'bul nus pa'am/ ma nus kyang par dpon rang gis bskang gso rgyun bzhag nus pa zhig byung na yid 'jog mdzod ces phebs kyang gsung lan ci yang zhu ma spobs/ rgyu mtshan bdag gi yang mes rme shod dge rab yin pa'i rgyus/ ya ma tshe thar zhes pa de bla ma phun tshogs la mgo sger btags byas/ ming la mgo yag skyabs zhes btags nas bdag rkyen bzang po stsal/ de'i bu jo mo skyabs zhes pa dpa' rtsal che zhing dgra thabs la rgod pas bla ma phun tshogs pa'i thugs rtsar zin/ gling mdo mang dang be ri sogs phyi nang dgra sde 'dul dus dmag dpon du bskos pas dgongs bzhed bzang po 'grub/ de'i bu jo phrug ces pa khri chen sangs rgyas bstan pa sku na gzhon nu'i skabs tshong dpon du bskos/ phyis su sku tshab bskos mir bdag rkyen bzhag de'i tsha bo jo tsha dkon mchog zhes pa wa ra pho brang du bskos mi bzhag des na mi rting bdag la thug pa'i bar bdag rkyen la ma bkod pa ci yang med kyang*/ bdag ni shes blo mkhos dka' dang bsod nams kyi 'phen shugs chung bas/ sa steng gi rgyal po chen por zhu 'bul byed phod pa'i 'khos ni ci yod snyam nas rang gar bsdad pa yin/ da ni rang tshe yang ci yod mi shes pas/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang thams cad gzigs pa'i bdag nyid nas/

bka' lung phebs don stong par lus song na/ rang nyid mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon gtan gyi skyabs gnas rin po che de nyid kyi thugs kyi bzhed pa mi rdzogs pa'am mi mnyes par gyur song na/ skye ba dang tshe rabs kun du mi legs pa'i gzhir 'gyur grang*/ bka' bzhin grub pa zhig byung na/ ji skad du/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i// ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gsang sngags pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mnyes par gyur na/ mchog thun mong gi bde legs thams cad bla ma mnyes pa las 'byung dgos par bshad pa'i phyir/ de las lhag pa'i bsgrub bya ci zhig snyam nas/ yod pa med pa'i 'dod par der bskang gso'i rgyun phyir gtor sgam 'og tu gtor ma dang*/ steng du mkhan chen pas bzhag pa'i mgon sku dang*/ tshul khrims ting 'dzin can bdag gis bzhengs pa'i tsandan dmar po la brkos pa'i gur mgon sku mtho tshad gcig dpal ldan lha mo'i sku tsandan dkar po las brkos pa de bas chung tsam dang*/ dpal mgon bram ze'i gzugs can/ e ka dza ṭī/ gnod sbyin yab yum gnyis/ pu tra ming sring gsum sku dngos tsandan dkar po dang me ris sogs tsandan dmar por brkos pa gser sbyang gis g.yogs pa rnams snyan dar bcas sku rten du bsgrigs/ 'og gi bskang gtor rnams lo re bzhin du brje rgyu dang*/ bskang gso btang mkhan gyi dge slong re zhig rang gis gang 'os re bzhag de nas kyang bskal pa nam gnas bar du/ dge slong bsnyen song tshad ldan byed pa re mgon blar bzhag nas/ de dag gi rten du spam phung gi ltag nas bdag dbang chod pa'i zhing sa nas zho bcu 'gro nges dang bcas rnams gtan 'jog bgyis pa 'di dag gong gsal ltar/ ljongs 'dir bstan srid nam gnas kyi bar bskang gso rgyun 'don rgyun mi chad cing gtan 'jog rnams mgon bla ba gcig nas gcig tu rtsis 'phrod mi nyams par yod dgos pa'i bkod sbyar gyi yi ger byas pa'o// 'dir smras pa/

bsam sbyor rtsom pa khyim pa'i so nam min// gtan 'jog ka ca gnyen zla'i gsos phyir min// gang phyir mchod pa'i nyer spyad gcig nas gcig /rtsis su sprod byar 'god la spro ba skyes// des bskyed bsod nams kha ba'i rdul brtsegs las// 'khor gsum rtogs bral yongs bsngo'i chu klung che// 'gro drug rgyud kyi sa gzhir 'khyil ba'i klong*// byang chub snying po'i 'dab stong dgod phyir bsngo// kun mkhyen bstan pa'i 'grel byed sa skya pa// de tshul 'doms pa'i rgyal po e waṃ pa// mchog zung bzhed srol bshad sgrub dbyangs snyan po// 'og min bar du lud par rgyas gyur cig /gnas lnga'i gzhung gi tshig bzang lam gyi mtha'// 'jal byed smra ba mkhas pa'i 'dab bzang dbang*// mkhas tshul gsum gyi sgro rtsal bskyod pa la// dus 'dzin dregs pa'i bgrod pa khegs gyur cig /klog spang bya ba'i 'khor lo rnam gsum gyis// rgyal ba'i gsung don lhur len ngur smrig 'chang*// nor 'dzin lus phra'i khur du ches lci bas/ phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor mdzes par brgyan gyur cig /rgyal bstan jus srid nyin mtshan mgon po zung*// chab 'bangs lcags ri'i khor yug rgyu ba'i khongs// bde skyid gzhon nu 'gugs pa'i sa skyong rje// sku tshe rigs stobs brgya byin rjes 'gror shog /mnga' 'bangs kyis mtshon ris bral skye 'gro rnams// nye bar 'tshe med bde 'byor rgyas pa la// dgyes dgur rtsen pas sum rtsen skal ba bzang*// sa steng 'di na 'phos snyam byed gyur cig /ces dge ba'i rtsa ba bstan pa dang sems can la phan zhing*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi rgyur bsngo ba ste/ de ltar gtan 'jog bkod sbyar gyi yi ge yid ches tshangs pa'i drang thig ces bya ba 'di nyid bzhag pa la/ slar yang dge rgyun bstan srid nam gnas kyi bar mi 'gyur bar brtan pa la ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang mdor bstan las/

gang na sa phyogs chos ldan zhing*// gang zhig kho nar skye dgu rnams// bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med pa'i// gnas der rnal 'byor brtsam par bya// zhes dkon mchog mchod pa la sogs pa dge ba'i rgyun ji tsam zhig bsgrubs kyang*/ de nam yang mi 'gyur bar yun du gnas pa la/ chos ldan gyi rgyal po'i bka' khrims rgyab brten med na bya ba ci dang ci brtsams kyang chu la ri mor bris pa lta bu las mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ rgyab non gyi gser tham zhus par/ dpal ldan bla ma khri chen pa nas 'di skad du bka' lung phebs te/ par dpon tshul khrims ting 'dzin pas/ bstan pa spyi dang bye brag pa dang*/ sde dge'i bstan jus chab 'bangs bcas par phan 'dod bsam sbyor gyis 'di ltar brtsams pa'i lhag bsam dge rgyun rtsis sprod dang bcas pa gong gsal 'bru don 'di dag bstan jus nam gnas drag zhan ser skya'i las byed phal pa bcas thams cad nas sor gnas kho na las/ 'gal zla byed mi chog cing*/ gal te 'gal zlar byas tshe nged kyi mi rim byon nas rtsed gcod nyes chad gtang nges yin pas/ khyod thams cad nas bsgo ba rnar gzon du ma song bar bya dgos/ zhes rab byung 'dod pa'i nang gsel sna tshogs zhes pa chu rta'i lor dpal lhun grub steng gi srib dgon gtsug lag khang du bskang gso rtag 'don gyi gtan 'jog gi yi ge mi 'gyur tshangs pa'i drang thig ces bya ba 'di ni par dpon tshul khrims ting 'dzin pa'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rgyal khab chen po'i grags pa'i mu khyud kyis bsrungs pa'i phyogs kyi ba gam du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// //rgyal ba'i dmigs med thugs rje'i shing rtar brten// bstan pa'i ma zlum dkyil 'khor skye dgu'i blar// shar ba mkhas tshul gsum gyi byi dor gyis// 'jig rten snang byed rgyal po sa skya pa// de tshul shes bya'i gzhung lugs yongs bzung nas// skal bzhin legs par 'doms pas snyigs ma 'dir// 'gro tshogs byang chen bkri dang lhan cig nyid// thub pa'i phrin las skyong mchog e waṃ pa// zung gis legs gsungs dri bral zil mngar gyis// lung rtogs yon tan dar bab 'dus pa'i sdes// bshad sgrub lhur len thub bstan chos kyi sde'i// spyi rdzas nyer mkho dgu yi gtan 'jog rnams// nam zhig ma pham rgyal bstan ma shar bar// de srid 'thor god nyams zad mi btub ched// bden dpang tshogs gsum rdo rje'i bzhad sgra 'dis// mdzol med 'doms la sgra 'dzin dbang por gtod// de'ang 'bri klung gser dang ldan ma dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs/

rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i chos tshul bshad sgrub zung 'jug gi cho gas gzhar yang mi nub ring du skyong ba'i thub bstan chos sde'i ngur smrig 'chang gi dge 'dun 'dus tshogs kyi spyi rdzas kyi deb yig tshogs gsum mi 'gyur rdo rje'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba 'god pa la/ slar yang smras pa/ de skad rgyal ba rgyal tshab bcas pa'i bstan// ring 'tsho'i gsos sman byed po 'dus tshogs kyis// nyer spyad dngos ming mi 'gyur phreng bstar nas// gcig nas gcig brgyud rtsis sprod spel phyir bris// rnyed dka'i dal rten dus las yol 'gyur ram// bkres phongs srog gi dbang po 'gags bla yi// dge 'dun 'du sgo phrogs pa'i rnam par smin// bskal mang sbyang rung min pa rgyal bas gsungs// dgon sde'i spyi rdzas nyams zad chud 'dza' yang*// ji mi snyam pa'i mi srun 'tsho ba'i rgyun// bka' srung dam can rgya mtshos yongs dpral nas// yang 'byung med par skye med dbyings su sgrol// rgyu 'bras bslu med nges pa'i blo ldan gyis// gtan 'jog dngos po mi nyams bla nas blar// 'phel ba'i bsam sbyor bskyed pa gang yin de'i// tshe dpal bsod nams dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel mdzod// yon sbyor lhag bsam bskyed pa'i legs byas klung*// byang chub rgyu tshogs chu gter cher sim nas// sku gsum yon tan nor bu'i 'byung chen gyis// mtha' yas gdul bya'i bsam kun rdzogs byed shog /ces thub bstan chos kyi sde'i spyi rdzas gtan 'jog rnams kyi deb yig tshogs gsum mi 'gyur rdo rje'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rnam par dpyod ldan sa 'dzin kun dga' blo gros pa'i bkas bskul 'phral bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ gtsug lag khang gzhan 'phrul mngon par dga' ba'i dbang phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// dga' ldan chos 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang steng du 'gan 'ji ra bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba dkar chag shel dkar me long bzhugs//

༄༅// bināyakāsarbadzñānabhawātrarūpai/ rdzināṃkurodharm+māḥkoṣaparigrahitwā/ bhagoyathākarm+meṇān+yasubhaṣiṇasyo/ ttaraṃsadāsatwāḥpālayanikarahiḥ/ ༄༅// rnam 'dren kun gyi ye shes srid pa 'dir// rgyal sras tshul gyis chos mdzod yongs bzung nas// skal bzhin legs par 'doms pa'i phrin las kyis// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad bla mas rtag tu skyongs// bgrang yas bskal pa'i tshogs zung chu gter snying stobs mi dman ded dpon gyis// dpag yas spyod grus pha rol legs brgal don gnyis lhun grub nor bu'i rgyal// nyer blangs srid zhi'i rgyal mtshan rtser 'dzegs chos phung 'dod dgu'i char che bas// rigs gsum gdul bya'i mos pa'i shing rta phyur bur 'gengs pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// sdang sems kyis dben sgrib pa gsum tshogs bag la nyal bcas zad par bza'// mngon zhen bral yang tshul bzhin bsten la 'dod dgongs snying po gang yin ster// rjod byed bzang po'i rgyud las nyer 'phos brjod bya bden gnyis mtshan nyid can// ji bzhin ston pas blo ldan kun dga'i dpal rab ster ba dam pa'i chos// nyi gzhon gyis phye sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan yid 'phrog dri bsung 'thul ba'i tshal// 'jam mnyen 'dab ma stong phrag grol ba'i ngo mtshar 'di kos srid dang zhi'i// 'jigs las skyob pa'i yon tan rdzogs na srid pa'i 'ching las ring song shing*// bdag med phyogs su blo gros rnam grol 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rjes su bsngags// lung rtogs yon tan dpag yas legs brnyes bla med yid srubs thul gyi sa// skad cig rnam par gnon pa'i stobs dang bsnyengs pa bral ba'i blo mnga' yang*// bskal bzang rnam 'dren bstan la rjes chags zla bral mkhas pa'i tshul gsum gyis// chos la las byas mchog tu grags pa'i 'phrin yig phyogs kyi rna lung snyan// de tshul dbyig 'dzin dkyil 'khor snang phyir gru 'dzin phyag na chu skyes mtshan// gser zhun cod paṇa 'chang ba'i sgyu 'phrul kha ba'i ljongs kyi do ra cher// skye bar zlos pa'i gar gyi rang gzugs ngag dbang gzhon nu mgrin chags pas// thams cad mkhyen dbang ri bo'i grangs ldan rim par byon rnams phyag bya'i yul// blo mchog rnams kyi lugs bzang srid pa 'di'i// rgyan du rgyas phyir sems dpa' che rnams kyis// thugs bskyed stobs kyi lag pas mngon bskrun pa'i// bshad sgrub dar babs chos sde grangs med las// gnam sngon zhun mar co 'dri'i shar zla yi// nyal 'gro'i rgyun chen rlabs kyi lag pa 'bum// mtha' bral stong pa'i mkha' la 'khyud snyam du// dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs ga la bar// dgaṃ' ldanaṃ theg gsum choṃs kyi 'khor lo yi// bshad dang sgrub pa'i dbyangs snyan bstan pa la// sdang ba'i bdud snying bzod dka'i rma 'byin yang*// dkar phyogs lha srung rab dga' 'phel ba'i gnas// bslab gsum lang tsho dar babs ngur pa'i phreng*// mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i bcud myos pas// dpyad gsum rnam dag bshad pa'i mgrin snyan gyis// rnam rtsen gtsug lag khang bzang padma'i rdzing*// rnam par snang byed rang bzhin khang bzang steng*// mdzes byed gser sbyangs las grub 'gan 'ji ra// rnam bzhi gsar bskrun las brtsams gtam gyi bzhin// snang byed dkar chag shel gyi me long ngom// bems chos sngags btab sgyu ma'i zlos gar la// lta byed ltad mo'i zil mngar 'thung byed na// mchog gsum rten gyis gtams pa'i gandho la'i// rgyan mchog bskrun pa'i 'phrin yig 'dren byed dpyid// 'gyur khugs snyan pa'i glur 'jo kun gyi rnar// lhang nger 'jebs pa ka la piṅka'i dbyangs// zhing bsam dngos po'i khyad par brjod min pas// ngo mtshar 'di yi rjes su nam zhig snyegs// zhes yul dam pa rnams la mchod par brjod cing dngos po nges bstan gyi tshig gis mdun bsu nas skabs su bab pa'i gleng ba/

rang gzhan thams cad srid pa'i dug can gyi bsti gnas chen po'i pha rol tu sgrol bar byed pa'i thabs bla na ma mchis pa nyid ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi dang rjes su 'brel bas bstan bya'i snying po sdom pa gsum gyi 'khor du byung ba'i dam pa'i chos nyams su len cing*/ lam gyi yon tan rgyud du bskyed pa'i sgo nas mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i 'bras bu don du gnyer ba la rag las mod kyi/ de'i rgyu ni sbyin pa gtong ba la sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs mngon par 'du bgyis pas mthar thug gi snying po sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku 'grub pa'i rgyu dang*/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong bsgom pa la sogs pa ye shes kyi tshogs kyis chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i rgyu byed de/ ji skad du/ gzugs kyi sku ni mdor bsdu na// rgyal po bsod nams tshogs las byung*// de bzhin du ni chos kyi sku// ye shes tshogs las byung ba yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na 'dir bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs kyi nang gsal/ mu stegs gcer bu sogs la ma grags pa ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa kho na'i khyad chos te/ khyad par 'phags bstod las/ gcer bu kun dga' rwa ba sogs// brtsigs pa sdig pa'i rgyu zhes zer// thams cad mkhyen pa khyod nyid ni// de nyid bsod nams rgyu zhes gsungs// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ khyad par srid pa gsum na yon gyi gnas dam pa ni dkon mchog gsum dang mtshungs pa 'ga' yang med de/ chos thams cad kyi rgyal po'i mdo las/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na// dkon mchog gsum po ma gtogs pa'i// yon gyi gnas 'ga' yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir yon gyi gnas bla na med pa dkon mchog gsum gyi rten gsum bzhugs pa'i gnas yin pa dang*/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag dge slong gi dge 'dun 'du ba'i gtsug lag khang brtsigs pa'i phan yon la/

ston pas bsngags pa rgya cher bstan pa dang mtshungs par gtsug lag khang mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan gyi mchog tu gyur pa gser zangs las grub pa'i 'gan 'ji ra bzhi po 'di dag bskrun pa ni dkon mchog gsum la dad cing gus pas mchod pa 'bul ba'i mchog tu 'gyur bas na/ bsod nams kyi tshad gzhal du ci zhig yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang mchod rten bzhugs pa'i khang par tshon rtsi tsam gsol bas sangs rgyas la mnga' ba'i yon tan rnams dang mnyam par 'gyur ba'ang*/ gsal rgyal la tshigs su bcad par/ su zhig sangs rgyas mchod rten sku gzugs khang*// tshon rtsi sna tshogs rnams kyis mdzes byas pa// de ni bde gshegs mnga' ba'i yon tan rnams// sna tshogs ldan pa kun gyis brtsegs par 'gyur// zhes sogs mang du 'byung ba'i phyir ro// des na tshul 'dir rgyu sbyor byed pa thams cad kyi rgyud la bsod nams kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phel ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba dang*/ bdud dang bar du gcod pa thams cad las rnam par rgyal te byang chub thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'ang*/ sangs rgyas phal po che las/ rigs par ldan pa dkon mchog gsum rnams la// sbyor ba skyo ba med par mchod byas na// de dag bdud bzhi'i lam las rab 'das nas// byang chub bla med myur du reg par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i tshul rnams rjes su thos nas/ thog mar zla rab 'byams pa zhes bya ba rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs kyi gsung las skyes pa'i dngos slob tu gyur cing mdo sngags kyi chos thams cad la chos mig dri med brnyes pa gang de bzhugs pa'i skabs de nyid kyis bskul ba ltar/ wa shul dpon bsod nams nor bus rgyu dang sbyor bkod phun sum tshogs pa sbyar te 'gan 'ji ra bzhi'i zangs kyi brdung bzo tsam grub nas/ de la sbyor rgyu gser dang bcas te nyer bsdogs bgyis so// de mtshams nas bla ma rab 'byams pa sku tshe dus kyi chos klong du nongs pa dang*/

gser zangs sbyor rgyu ma byung bar lus pa'i skabs shig nas/ mi ring bar bsod nams nor bu rang gi jus srid la'ang mi bde ba byung ba bcas/ las kyi 'phro lus bsdoms pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub mkhan sde dpon/ dgon sde gang nas kyang ma byung bar bgrang gzhi bco lnga tsam gyi bar du lus pa/ phyis su g.yu rab 'byams pa che ge mo zhes bya bas lha gnyer lo gsum bar du byas shing*/ dus mchod kyi rgyun dang mar me rgyun 'bar bcas dgos srol mchis pa thams cad ma chag par dkon mchog phyogs la blo gtad tshul gyis legs par byas mthar/ spyi rdzas kyi gtan 'jog gcig nas gcig tu rtsis 'phrod bya ba rnams kyang sngon gyi deb 'khod ltar ma tshang med par 'phrod pa'i khar/ gsar 'phar yang ja 'khor drug nyi shu byung ba dang*/ pho brang gi rdzong sdod par 'khod pa sa 'dzin mgon po pas kyang gser zho dgu zhal gsos su bstab cing las kyi 'phro bsdoms kyi ched du/ gser zangs sbyor ba dang*/ de'i las byed pa bcas pa'i bdag rkyen sde dge 'dun sa chen po nyid du mi zhu thabs med byung nas zhus par/ rmad du byung ba'i bsod nams kyi mthu dang stobs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs ma brgya pas/ tha gru rnam par yangs pa'i nor ldan brtan ma'i dkyil 'khor chen por mnga' bsgyur yang khengs pa dang rgyags pa'i dri ma mi mnga' zhing*/ gcig tu rnam dkar dge ba sgrub pa'i phyogs la snying stobs dang spro ba mchog tu brtas pas rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rgya chen po spyad pa'i sa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sa skyong blo gros rgya mtsho pa nyid nas/ thugs dgyes chen pos de bzhin btub pa'i zhal bzhes swasti snyan pa'i gdangs su bsgyur ba dang bcas pas gnang nas/ de'i grogs ldan dgos tshul dang bka'i bkod pa bcas/ par dpon dge slong tshul khrims ting 'dzin pa la legs par stsal pa dang*/ de nyid nas kyang bstan don dang dge ba'i rtsa ba lhan cig tu dgongs pa'i mgo 'dren yang dag par gnang nas brtsams pa mthar phyin pa byung ngo*// de ltar bzo mthar phyin nas/

nang rten 'jug rgyur byin rlabs rten gyi rigs dang*/ chos sku'i ring bsrel du grags pa'i nang gzungs la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan gzungs/ rgyud sde gong 'og nas bstan pa'i yi dam gyi lha rnams dang*/ chos srung nor lha rnams kyi gzungs dang gzungs chen sde lnga ste/ de dag la rgyas pa'i spel tshig gis mtha' brgyan pa dang*/ 'dod don gsol ba bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa bcas te cha tshang ba re phul ba bcas zla tshes dge ba'i nyin gtsug lag khang gi logs bzhir gzungs su gsol lo// slar yang bzo mthar phyin pa'i bya ba ni/ ji skad du/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ gang du sku gzugs rdzogs pa la// byin ma brlabs par ring gnas na// de las bkra mi shis 'gyur zhing*// ji srid mchod pa der mi 'os// zhes 'byung ba ltar rab tu gnas pa zab mo'i rten 'brel gyi tshogs dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus par 'dus pa'i zhing khams chen por byin gyis brlabs zin pas tshul 'di la brten nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde zhing lo legs pa dang bkra shis bde legs thams cad rtag tu 'phel bar 'gyur ba nyid do// de ltar ji ltar bshad pa'i phan yon de dag bar ma dor chud mi 'dza' ba'i phyir/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba ni/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i kun gsal lus phra'i bzhin// gang du phyin pa de srid gshegs shing bzhugs// gang dag 'jig rten mgon po sras dang bcas// gang bsam bsngos pa 'grub pa'i dpang por spyon// deng 'dir skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog gsum// rten gsum tshul gyis bzhugs par mchod phyir dang*// bstan pa'i bshad sgrub lhur len 'dus pa'i sder// 'jig rten mchod pa'i yul du bkur sti'i phyir// dri gtsang khang pa'i rtse mor spa ba'i rgyan// rin chen mdog bzang rang bzhin 'gan 'ji ra'i// 'od zer stong gi lag pa ring brkyangs nas// 'gro ba thar pa'i grong du 'khrid pa bzhin// gang zhig bskrun la mkho ba'i smar zong rdzas// che chung bar ma'i gtong ba gang bgyis pa// chu gter dag byed rgyun nas chu thigs bar// rjes 'gro dge ba'i dngos po'i 'brel thogs bcas// bstan la sman 'dogs lhag bsam gyis bskyed pa'i// lus ngag yid kyis gus sbyor brtson pa'i khur// nye bar blangs mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i las// ji snyed blo yi byed pos bsdoms pa'i mthus// gang zhig thos na dad pa'i rtsa ba brling*// bsams byung blo gros lo 'dab phyogs su rgyas// bsgoms don rtogs pa'i yon tan mañdza ris// nyer dud rgyal bstan dpag bsam rkang 'thung 'di// mong rtul lha min skal bas ma thob cing*// blo ldan gnyid bral yongs kyis bsten bya ba// byin rlabs phan bde'i dgos 'dod ci dang ci// 'dzad med rtag tu 'jo yin rgyas gyur cig

/bsil ldan thub pa'i ring lugs smra ba'i dbus// 'dab stong khrod na u dumbā ra ltar// snyan dngags bye ba'i 'bab stegs btsong kha pa'i// bstan pa bskal pa'i yun du rgyas gyur cig /de tshul dri med klog spong 'khor lo yis// ring 'tshor sgrub la dga' ba'i blo ldan tshogs// grangs med 'dus pa'i chos gos gsum tshon gyis// nor 'dzin dkyil 'khor bkab snyam 'phel gyur cig /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed smon lam gyi// dri bzhon gyis bsdus sa skyong ri bo'i rgyal// bstan srid nyi zla'i snang ba ring 'phro zhing*// chab srid rgya mtsho'i dpyid du brtan gyur cig /tshul 'dir bsgo gsum rtun dang dngos rdzas kyi// 'brel thogs ji snyed rnam pa thams cad mkhyen// mngon du gyur min de srid dal 'byor rten// rgyal bstan dri med rjes su slob par shog /gnas lnga'i gzhung lugs thos pa'i rna ba yangs// thos don dpyod pa'i 'dren byed dkyus su ring*// 'gro la 'doms pa'i mchu 'dab ches snyung pa'i// blo ldan yid 'phrog zla bzhin ngoms par shog /ma bos 'khor bar 'phyan pa'i yid can rnams// ma bcos rang bzhin sdig spong dge bar spyod// ma 'dris mdza' bshes skyabs gsum gtsug gis bsten// ma bskul thugs rje'i snang bas bsrung gyur cig /mkhyen brtse nus pa dpag yas sangs rgyas chos tshogs gsum// skyabs su bsten rnams gzhar yang mi bslu nges pa'i gtam// bden pa'i rnga chen srid gsum khongs su ldir ba yis// smras don snye ma gegs med 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub kyi rgyur yongs su bsngo ba ste/ de dag gis gleng ba mdor bsdus brjod zin to// slar yang smras pa/ mkhyen brtse nus gter bla ma dkon mchog gsum// gzugs brnyan tshul gyis skye dgur bde ster ba// gang dag bsti gnas mdzes pa'i 'gan 'ji ra// gsar bzo'i tshogs gsum brjod pa de tsam mo// dge bas lung rtogs chos kyi gdung skyob dkar// de 'dzin bshad sgrub yu ba brling ldan rtser// byin rlabs phan bde'i grib bsil 'khor ba'i mtha'// mthong min de srid kun khyab rgyas gyur cig

/bdag dang ltos bcas lus can padma'i tshal// rtag tu rgyal bstan rta ljang 'od 'thungs pas// blo gros 'dab stong rnam par grol ba'i sbubs// legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i mgrin snyan 'jo bar shog /ces shar zla'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun chen dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs kyi dgon gsar dga' ldan chos 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang steng du gser zangs las grub pa'i 'gan 'ji ra bzhi ji ltar bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba dkar chag shel dkar me long zhes bya ba 'di/ sde dge sa skyong chen po'i phrin las kyi kha lo sgyur ba'i sa 'dzin mgon po zhes bgyi ba'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen nam 'byung 'gyur gyi yon tan la smon pa'i btags ming du ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyan pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bgyi bas dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab chen po'i dbang phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa'o// ༈ /swasti siddhi rastu/ rnam 'dren kun gyi lhun grub phrin las nyid// lang tsho dar bab ye shes sgyu ma'i gar// gsol ba btab 'phral 'jigs brgyad bcu drug las// 'gro ba skyob phyir sgrol ma zhes grags la// gang 'tsham phrin las bsgrub phyir thugs rje'i gzugs// chu zla'i gar mtshungs lha mo nyi shu gcig /blo ster mi g.yo mgon por bcas pa'i sku// gnyer pa a zlos bsod nams rten du bskrun// dge bas gnas skabs nad gdon gnod pa dang*// dus min 'chi sogs 'jigs las rnam bsgral nas// mthar thug bsod nams tshogs rdzogs rgyal ba'i sku// legs brnyes 'gro ba 'dren pa'i mchog gyur cig /ces zhal byang smon lam bcas 'di/ bande tshul rin gyis bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
